JAL TRANS PACIFIC SERVICES
now... enjoy personalized
Japan Air Lines' service
all the way to
Hong Kong!
By popular demand, JAL has expanded its famous
DC-6B San Francisco-Tokyo service all the way to
Hong Kong. Now more than ever, JAL is the route
to the Orient. Swift, dependable...a rewarding new
experience in hospitality and service aloft.
